scenes.text: The *one-product store* weekend, with Shopify Canvas

scenes.title: Friday: *pick the product*
lines: One thing you can make or source in a week: candles, a print, a digital template.
Claude prompt: 'Give me 10 one-product store ideas under $20 to make, with a 3x markup.'

scenes.title: Saturday: *build the store*
lines: Start the Shopify trial: 3 days free, then $1 a month for 3 months.
Sidekick prompt: 'Dark minimal store for one soy candle: big hero photo, 3 benefits, reviews, FAQ, free-shipping bar.'

scenes.title: Saturday: *the photos*
lines: Shoot the real product by a window on your phone. Lifestyle shots can come from Canva Craft, but the hero must be real.
Eight photos: front, side, in hand, in use.

scenes.title: Sunday: *launch*
lines: Ask ChatGPT for 7 days of short-video scripts about the product.
Post one a day. Offer a launch code to the first 20 orders.

scenes.title: The *math*
lines: Candle costs $6 to make, sells for $24. After 2.9% plus 30 cents processing, about $17 profit each.
20 orders a month is about $340. A side income, not a salary.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Canvas is desktop only and can't use third-party themes yet.
Most first stores sell to friends first. Source: TechCrunch, Oct 1, 2026; Shopify pricing, Oct 2026.
